Episode 184. Beyond Fate (20)
Vroom-!
Murakan threw a punch at the grotesque deity with all his might.
The shockwave caused by the contact between the fist and the sword made the massive soul energy surrounding the three of them sway.
Unlike Jin or the members of the Myungwang tribe, Murakan did not have complete immunity to the soul energy.
Nevertheless, because the power of his original form was too great, it was impossible to infect him with any ordinary strike.
Although he hadn't fully regressed, he was closer to his prime than during the first total offensive.
The grotesque deity was the first to back down. Murakan created lumps of soul energy in both hands and fired them towards the deity who had kept a distance.
"Hahaha, I just didn't have time back then! Do you think I would be scared of something like you? Oh, damn. It stings like hell!"
After saying so, Murakan quickly whispered to Jin again.
'Kid, in fact, I don't have a lot of time this time either, you know?'
'Misha said it would be like that.'
Currently, Murakan's absence is equivalent to the absence of Solderet.
If he is absent from 'God's Domain' for a long time, the world order regarding shadows could collapse in an instant.
'But if I just buy you some time to recover and then leave, I think you'll be able to finish it alone. You've already hurt him quite a bit. You did well, making him like that.'
Murakan now has the divinity of Solderet.
Therefore, he could see an area that could not be confirmed with mortal eyes.
If Jin was in good shape, he could easily handle the current grotesque deity alone.
'It wasn't me, it was the work of Half Brothers. Just protect me for about a minute first.'
'Okay.'
Whoosh…!
Murakan transformed into his true form and spread his wings.
The grotesque deity, filled with intense hostility, poured its sword energy towards Murakan.
An intense battle was unfolding outside as well.
Padler was showing a not at all retreating posture against Bale unlike before, and the newly arrived army of chaos was too large.
More than anything, the problem was the mental attacks through the soul energy and the number of black knights.
The allies wondered if the grotesque deity hadn't revived all the historical black knights of Runcandel.
The four heads of the previous generation were effectively commanding all those black knights.
However, Jin and Murakan did not have the leisure to pay attention to the outside.
Jin took out a jewel-like object from his bosom that looked like a round ruby.
It looked similar to the wave tracking synchronization device, but it was an object with a completely different purpose and name.
Numerus's Blood.
It was a divine object that Jin had received from Ziphlo in advance for the decisive battle.
Right now, Jin was neither fatally wounded nor on the brink of death, but he didn't hesitate to put the blood in his mouth and chew.
He used it simply to regain his strength, to fight the grotesque deity in perfect condition again.
It was a fight worth that much. Not just blood, even if it was tears.
Crunch!
As the god's blood filled his mouth, Jin felt a rapid disappearance of exhaustion.
His eyes regained their vitality, his heart was pumping blood throughout his body at an insane rate.
His muscles were tense as if they were about to explode at any moment, and his senses became infinitely sharp.
The darkened battlefield gradually regained its original light.
Exactly one minute later, Jin was able to hold the sword again in a more perfect state than ever before.
The aura wrapped around Jin's body forming a dazzling protective shield. Then magic swirled around, spreading in all directions, and soul energy surrounded Bradamante.
Through the spread of magic like a curtain, a summoning gate was opening.
[Ahhhh!]
The dead world known as the grotesque deity's fortress was already completely broken and had become a part of Ram, so Tess could be summoned again.
"Oh, surprise! Give me a warning when you call me!"
As Tess spat fire, his aura and soul energy were added to it.
Fire of Oblivion.
And the Eternal Flame.
The two fires symbolizing the magic sword of Runcandel were pushing back the incoming chaos.
Murakan, like Misha, could not combine the black shadow into the fire of oblivion, but just added a massive amount of soul energy, enhancing the fire of oblivion.
What's piercing the grotesque deity now would not be just a sword.
The will of the fire that has followed the history of Runcandel for a thousand years, Jin gritted his teeth as he twisted the sword piercing the chest of the grotesque deity.
[Cough!]
"My family, my house, my dead brothers, countless innocent people! They died and were destroyed by your hands!"
Jin was shouting out of anger without realizing it.

"The strongest Runcandel in history? A family that is not threatened by anything? What you wanted to do is something that not even my father, Temar, and even the gods could do. Look at the results of your reckless actions! The Garden of Swords is broken, the knights, the family......!"
[Shut up! If the family was so precious, you should have never left here, neither you nor Chiron! I'm saying my choice was not wrong!]
"Die!"
What drove Jin mad was the fact that even if he killed the grotesque deity, the things that were already broken couldn't come back.
He simply couldn't fight while maintaining his composure.
It didn't matter. Now, he was sure that he could tear the grotesque deity into thousands, tens of thousands of pieces and kill it.
However, even doing so wouldn't have eased this rage.
The pain of the people who have already died by the beast's hands, and those who have been left behind, would not disappear.
Shick!
Jin slashed his embedded sword sideways.
The beast immediately recovered and showed signs of absorbing the eternal flame just as before.
With a malicious look, Jin stabbed the same spot again, twisted, and cut.
Whenever the beast tried to avoid, Murakan forcibly moved her.
Jin and Murakan began to acquire wounds one by one.
Blood, spirit, and soul mixed together and colored the void.
During the continued eternal flame, the decisive strike and the spirits of Runcandel clashed incessantly.
Meteor showers and dark meteor showers rained down simultaneously, and the dizzying sight of sword lights and dark sword lights flying towards each other's necks at nearly light speed.
Falling flowers and falling flowers, lightning and lightning, black crucifix and golden circle, crashing waves and crashing waves...
Carelessly powerful swords that could shatter even superhuman bodies and godlike bodies battered the once compatible duo. They were stabbing and cutting each other.
Breathing became rapid and the throat kept choking, vomiting blood.
During the bloody battle that lasted over thirty minutes, the beast lost its physical form more than twenty times.
Whether the neck was cut, the body was split in half, scattered into six pieces, or completely incinerated without a trace.
The beast revived endlessly, regenerating.
Would the family be able to recover and revive so tenaciously?
Can this family called Runcandel, with only a few people left, rise again after this fight...
Occasionally when such questions arose, moisture formed in Jin's eyes.
Certainly he would do so, but he missed the sceneries he could no longer see more than ever.
The dark, cold sword garden of his previous life where he had nowhere to go.
The cold and cruel people who dealt with his previous self.
The cruel family he had no choice but to leave in his previous life.
Even those painful memories were missed to the point of feeling like his heart would rot.
If someone stole his privilege of regression and could turn Runcandel back to those times, even if his banished self couldn't meet Valeria and ended up dying in obscurity somewhere.
If he could choose, Jin would definitely nod.
He would plead to restore the family even if he himself lived miserably and disappeared.
"There won't be such a thing, because there won't be a chance given to me. I have to kill you and bear a heavy duty... the duty of Runcandel. The duty to rebuild a land where Runcandel stands tall."
Jin swung his sword, spouting a monologue that neither the beast nor Murakan could understand.
The body that had recovered with Numerus's blood felt heavy again as if it had been submerged in water.
The beast's regeneration also slowed, and the body did not form quickly.
No one in the world.
"Nobody would want to kill their mother.
They would not want to be such a mother's child, nor would they want to be destined to save the world from such a mother.
It was the same for Jin. He never wanted such a future.
He was just fighting against it, a point of inevitability that he had to accept.
He was just getting over it.
"Ah!"
Jin, screaming and brandishing Bradamante.
The raging flame disappeared and Tess returned to the flame realm.
Murakan was still present, protecting Jin from further injury by blocking his soul energy with his body.
Swish!
The black blade wrapped in soul energy scratched the chest of the beast.
Then, for the first time, the beast spit out scarlet blood instead of soul energy. As if it were a human spewing blood.
The eternal flame, which had been continuously absorbed, left a faint blue flame on the beast's chest for the first time.
The beast clutched the fire.
[Swish, gasp……!]
The beast spat out a heavy breath mixed with the sound of metal.
The beast's horns and two wings, trembling, were slowly melting away.
The soul energy that wrapped the body was falling to the ground like a rough scaled skin.
Finally, the eternal flame that set the beast's chest on fire began to sweep away the soul energy.
As the seconds passed, the beast was becoming more and more like a human.
Jin aimed his sword without suppressing his awkward feelings.
And he felt intuitively.
This fight will eventually end in a fight between the beast and himself, without Vahn, Murakan, or other colleagues.
[Little guy, are you okay?]
As Jin nodded his head, the storm of soul energy that enveloped the three people continued.
The storm quickly engulfed the three people.
[It's a last resort. If you use this much soul energy in that state, there won't be a next time. I still have some time left, so let's break through first, and when the soul energy subsides...…….]
"No, Murakan. You go first."
[What? Why?]
"The outer battlefield is being pushed back. Go help. Anyway, this soul energy can't hurt me."
Murakan was about to add something, but when he saw Jin putting his hand into the storm of soul energy, he flapped his wings. Unlike before, the storm of soul energy did not harm Jin at all.
"It's the last one-on-one. I'll win as always, so wait while saving one more person. You're the guardian of Runcandel, right? You have to play a role that suits him."
Jin said that and slowly moved towards the beast.
